events.title: Google Gemini 2.5 Pro released
events.summary: Google released [Gemini] 2.5 Pro on March 25, 2025 — a thinking model topping LMArena with strong coding, math, and a 1M-token context window.
events.about: [Gemini] 2.5 Pro was Google's first 2.5 thinking model: hybrid [reasoning], native multimodality, and state-of-the-art [benchmark] scores. It arrived in AI Studio and [Gemini] Advanced as Google raced [OpenAI]'s o3 and [Anthropic]'s Claude 3.7 for developer mindshare.

narrative.whyChosen: [Gemini] 2.5 Pro put Google back at the top of public leaderboards for [reasoning] models.
narrative.whyImportant: Thinking models with million-token context became the new frontier baseline.
narrative.problemSolved: [Teams] needed a Google model that matched o-series [reasoning] without leaving Vertex or AI Studio.
